summary: Independent review found no blocker or important finding for the 24 CHROMASS RAW acquisitions. C/no-DNA assignment is disclosed as inference in the evidence manifest.

reviewer_context.context: Fresh isolated reviewer agent; no producer transcript or artifact edits.

spec_compliance.evidence: Read TERMS.tsv, templates.yaml and active base, sample-metadata, ms-proteomics 1.1.0 and vertebrates 1.1.0 YAML; 24 rows each have 31 cells. csv.reader preserves two cleavage columns, two template columns and three modification columns.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Official parse_sdrf union validation with OLS cache passed; offline ontology checker found 0 hallucinated, label mismatched, wrong-ontology or UNIMOD-swapped terms. PRIDE accession and organism/instrument checked against project JSON.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE project JSON accession PXD024280 and PMC8982572 Methods confirm Xenopus laevis, CHROMASS quadruplicate sperm chromatin conditions, LysC then trypsin, Q Exactive HF-X, DDA/HCD, 300-1750 m/z, 25 NCE, duplicate injections, label-free analysis and variable oxidation/acetylation. C=no-DNA remains a disclosed inference from filename C plus paper no-DNA comparison.

file_mapping.evidence: Every entry of accession-scoped files.json has projectAccessions=[PXD024280]. All 24 unique SDRF RAW names equal accession-scoped chromass_raw_selected.json and occur in deposited file list; no duplicates or missing CHROMASS RAW.

design_consistency.evidence: Filename grammar independently parsed for every row; C, M and UV each have R1-R4 and TR1-TR2 (8 acquisitions each). Source names, biological and technical replicate fields and factor values agree with filenames and stated condition mapping.

omission_safety.evidence: Inspected all 31 columns and unique values. No unsupported sample-specific sex, stage, anatomical part or disease was asserted; not available used where appropriate. Paper supports modification, cleavage and MS settings, and the material C-control inference is explicitly identified.

deterministic_validation.evidence: Exit 0: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --use_ols_cache_only (Everything seems to be fine); python3 -m tools.cli structure (Structure OK); check --offline (CLEAN, 0 hallucinations); score (88/100; only optional precursor/fragment tolerance columns absent).
